purpose: Machine-readable PINNacle-aligned benchmark contracts and non-binding PDE-PINN guidance.

families.reason: PINNacle benchmark identity must be fixed before architecture or optimizer knowledge is transferred.
families.trusted_equation: u_t + u * u_x - nu * u_xx = 0, nu = 0.01/pi

reference_metrics.reported_origin: PINNacle best benchmark result reproduced in PINNsAgent Table 2
reference_metrics.protocol_note: External reference only; do not compare until official reference data and matched protocol are used.

training_protocol.budget_rule: Never present a run below 5000 actual optimizer steps as a completed model training run.
training_protocol.seed_policy: Use repeated seeds for claims; a single seed is diagnostic only.

engineering_notes: Treat MSE and relative L2 error as different metrics; never compare their numeric values as if interchangeable.
Do not treat low boundary or initial error as sufficient; require solution error and steep-gradient-region error.
Do not claim superiority over PINNacle or PINNsAgent unless equation, official reference, training budget, seeds and metric protocol all match.

families.reason: Use PINNacle methods as comparison anchors while retaining open-ended, safety-checked evolutionary search.

then.initial_population_policy: Include a vanilla PINN control, executable adaptive-sampling/loss variants, and diverse safe architectures; preserve random exploration early.
then.late_search_policy: Increase elite crossover and posterior-knowledge mutation only after sufficient evaluated evidence; keep novelty injection and restart paths to escape local optima.
then.safety_policy: Only registered and validated runtime components may execute; candidate-only methods remain proposals until builder and safety tests pass.
then.metric_policy: Rank by the project's composite score, but always retain raw MSE, relative L2, residual, constraint, stability and cost metrics.
